scope: Ảnh mô phỏng ý tưởng; không tạo model 3D hoặc gameplay

prompts.A: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide 16:9 full-screen game environment concept, not a poster. Imagine a playable living-world narrative RPG set in a fictional ancient Vietnamese river settlement inspired by Văn Lang–Âu Lạc. Art direction A: sophisticated hand-painted 2D oblique game view, elevated camera about 40 degrees, fine broken ink edges under confident opaque gouache shapes, selective detail and visible brush decisions. Show Bến Vạc on an ordinary overcast morning after rain: a work yard on riverbank at the meeting of footpath and narrow wooden jetty. The playable situation is immediately readable: an OPEN narrow wooden canoe on TWO SEPARATE waist-low trestles on DRY LAND, one lighter replacement plank against its hull, a craftsperson crouched beside it; a small workbench nearby. A modest bamboo-and-thatch WORKSHOP CANOPY stands behind the boat, clearly independent of the hull. A second villager waits by two delivery baskets at the landing, a young protagonist in plain woven clothing approaches along the open path, one family works in background near stilt-house. Keep 3–4 human figures anatomically simple but clearly individually posed, no crowds. The far river occupies the upper right, muddy path and warm grey silvered timber foreground, banana leaves and dull olive reeds grouped into calm shapes. Palette is deliberately narrow and materially specific: chalky warm grey timber, raw umber earth, desaturated olive foliage, slate grey water; a tiny brick-red cloth is the only strong color. Diffuse neutral daylight, no golden sunset, no teal-orange grade, no bloom, no universal beige wash. Image should feel like an authored game background, with large navigable quiet spaces and one sharp focal worksite; do not texture every surface equally. Handmade Vietnamese domestic architecture, plain undecorated ceramics, no East Asian tiled pagodas, no Chinese/Japanese torii, no medieval European armor. Fictional art concept, not archaeological reconstruction. No text, no HUD, no title, no logos, no frame, no vignette. Make an original new view, not a copy of previous generated riverside scenes.
prompts.B: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide 16:9 simulated 3D RPG gameplay screenshot, raster concept only, not a real model. Art direction B: tangible authored 3D world with painted realistic materials, compact modest geometry, natural scale, restrained ambient occlusion, NO miniature diorama / toy / clay / plastic look. Camera just above a standing person's shoulder, offset slightly right and tilted gently down so we see both an open walkway and the workbench; 28–35mm equivalent, not cinematic shallow focus. Fictional ancient Vietnamese river village Bến Vạc inspired by Văn Lang–Âu Lạc. Stand at the EDGE of a separate bamboo workshop shelter looking out toward the landing. Protagonist lower left, seen from behind waist up in plain dark indigo woven shirt; in middle distance a boatwright bends over a long OPEN wooden canoe lying on TWO clear timber trestles on land. Canoe has exposed ribs and one pale replacement plank, absolutely NO cabin, NO roof on hull. The shelter roof ends across top left frame, with posts separate from boat. Tools are few and believable: wood mallet, adze, coil of dark fiber rope, one pottery water jar; foreground bench corner grounds viewpoint, wet earth with actual footworn path around boat. Beyond, a waiting villager and two baskets on the jetty, cool river and opposite reed bank. The emotional point is joining an ordinary person's work and obligations in a lived world, not sightseeing in a majestic fantasy vista. Controlled materials: weathered silver-grey timber, earthy brown wet mud, dull blue-grey river, distinct dark green banana foliage and unbleached natural textile; allow small terracotta accents. Neutral soft morning daylight with a weak cool sky bounce, no orange/teal LUT, no exaggerated saturation or magical glowing particles, no fog drowning depth. Broad value grouping, readable silhouettes and walkable space, selective roughness detail; not uniform noise. Vietnamese vernacular bamboo/thatch/stilt structures, no tiled temples, no European armor, no generic Chinese lantern street. All scene elements plausible and grounded, no giant props. No text, no HUD, no title, no logos, no borders. The image only imagines a possible 3D game, not a mesh or real engine render.
prompts.C: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide 16:9 screen of a possible 2.5D hand-painted narrative RPG. Art direction C is RADICALLY DIFFERENT CAMERA AND SHAPE DESIGN from elevated isometric village pictures: lateral side-on view across a riverside boat repair yard, like an intimate hand-built theatrical stage painted with tempera and dry pastel, crisp overlapping planes, restrained pen contours, tactile flat color, quiet Japanese-free Vietnamese vernacular. Eye line at waist height, camera orthographic SIDE VIEW with a slight upward glimpse beneath the shelter; horizontal movement path along the bottom third. An OPEN low wooden canoe rests on TWO plainly visible crossed timber repair supports at center left on earthen bank, exposed ribs visible, no cabin or roof on canoe. A boatwright at its stern checks a single lighter patch plank while a young adult protagonist at center has stopped to listen. One villager waits with delivery baskets to the right beside a low jetty that leads into grey river. Workshop canopy is a freestanding bamboo frame occupying only the upper left background, physically separate from canoe. Village and reed riverbank form only two spare receding layers; long horizontal waterline on right, a clouded off-white sky visible above. Foreground banana stem and an irregular dark wood beam at image edge frame scene without enclosing it. Compose an uninterrupted legible walking strip through scene and a distinct repair focal point; no crowded prop soup. Thin limited palette: charcoal-brown dry brushed timbers, cold fog-grey river, muted dusty green leaves, bone-white cloudy sky and tiny vermilion cloth accent; warm soil stays earthy neutral, not sepia. Hand-painted pigment variation within large flat shapes, some areas intentionally barely marked, not photorealism, not pixel art, no 3D plastic shading. Dignified ordinary working people in plain short woven garments, natural adult anatomy, no exaggerated cute/chibi proportions. Fictional ancient Vietnamese world inspired by Văn Lang–Âu Lạc, not historical evidence. No ornate pagodas, curved tiled roofs, torii, Chinese lanterns, armor, weapons or fantasy glowing plants. No text, no labels, no HUD, no logo, no frame. Create a compelling playable screen, not a book cover or a panoramic tourism painting.
